payload.system: Split a transmission project title into its named endpoints (substations or places). Return at most two names, without voltages, numbers or words like Rebuild/Line/Substation.
payload.prompt:
Title: Okatie 230-115kV Substation, Jasper – Yemassee 230kV #1 Fold-in
Description: Expand existing Okatie Transmission sub, add a 230-115 autobank and fold the Jasper – Yemassee 230 kV #1 line into the 230 kV side. Construct two additional 115 kV bus tie lines.
